stories.title: Violences en marge des mobilisations lycéennes : un lycéen de 15 ans et demi poursuivi pour «acte de barbarie» et placé en détention provisoire à Marseille

en.title: Violence during high school protests: 15-year-old pursued for 'act of barbarity' and placed in provisional detention in Marseille
en.summary: A minor in Marseille was charged with an act of barbarity after allegedly burning a woman's face with an inflamed spray during high school protests. The victim, a 40-year-old care worker, was attempting to prevent damage to a bus shelter.

stories.title: Mobilisation lycéenne : un adolescent mis en examen et placé en détention provisoire pour l'agression d'une femme avec un spray inflammable à Marseille

en.title: High school mobilization: adolescent examined and placed in provisional detention for attacking a woman with flammable spray in Marseille
en.summary: A 15-year-old was charged with an act of barbarity in connection with an assault on a woman using flammable spray during high school protests in Marseille.

stories.title: Femme brûlée avec un spray inflammable à Marseille : un mineur de 15 ans placé en détention provisoire

en.title: Woman burned with flammable spray in Marseille: 15-year-old minor placed in provisional detention
en.summary: A 15-year-old was charged with an act of barbarity and detained in a juvenile prison in Marseille following an incident in which a woman was burned with flammable spray.

stories.title: Passage à tabac d'un policier à Belfort : deux mineurs interpellés sont poursuivis pour violences volontaires, une information judiciaire ouverte

en.title: Police officer beaten in Belfort: two minors questioned are being prosecuted for assault, judicial investigation opened
en.summary: Two minors were arrested in connection with an assault on a police officer in Belfort. A 17-and-a-half-year-old, whom the officer had attempted to arrest in a river, admitted during questioning to kicking the officer twice.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Kiev « achètera davantage d’armes et d’équipements à l’Allemagne », assure Volodymyr Zelensky lors d’une visite de Frierich Merz à Kiev

en.title: LIVE: War in Ukraine: Kyiv "will buy more weapons and equipment from Germany", assures Volodymyr Zelensky during Friedrich Merz's visit to Kyiv
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that Kyiv intends to increase purchases of weapons and equipment from Germany. He added that collaboration on drone unit creation in Germany has begun, with Ukraine ready to provide training and expertise support.

stories.title: Policier roué de coups à Belfort en marge de la mobilisation lycéenne : deux mineurs de 15 et 17 ans poursuivis pour violences aggravées

en.title: Police officer beaten in Belfort during high school mobilization: two minors aged 15 and 17 charged with aggravated violence
en.summary: Two minors have been charged with aggravated violence following an incident in which a police officer was assaulted in Belfort. The minor the officer attempted to apprehend has filed a countersuit for attempted murder.

stories.title: Bardella accusé d’antisémitisme : Marine Le Pen réaffirme «sa confiance en Jordan»

en.title: Bardella accused of antisemitism: Marine Le Pen reaffirms "her confidence in Jordan"
en.summary: Marine Le Pen has renewed her support for Jordan Bardella, the National Rally party president, following antisemitic writings attributed to him in a media investigation. Several party officials have also publicly backed Bardella.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées : cours suspendus dans 400 à 500 établissements lundi, 24 ont été «saccagés ou incendiés», selon Edouard Geffray

en.title: High school blockade: classes suspended in 400 to 500 schools Monday, 24 have been "vandalized or burned", according to Edouard Geffray
en.summary: A government minister reported that classes will be suspended in hundreds of schools Monday due to safety concerns. He noted that 24 establishments have been vandalized or burned as demonstrations by student and education unions continue.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : entre 400 et 500 établissements totalement ou «partiellement» fermés lundi, 24 ont été «incendiés ou saccagés», annonce Édouard Geffray

en.title: School blockades: between 400 and 500 establishments totally or 'partially' closed Monday, 24 were 'set on fire or ransacked', announces Édouard Geffray
en.summary: France's education minister reported that between 400 and 500 schools faced closures on Monday due to blockades, with 24 establishments damaged by fire or vandalism. The week saw widespread violence and degradation across secondary schools, with further mobilization planned from Tuesday.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées : entre « 400 et 500 » lycées vont suspendre des cours ce lundi, annonce le ministre de l’éducation, Edouard Geffray

en.title: School blockages: between '400 and 500' secondary schools will suspend classes on Monday, announces education minister Edouard Geffray
en.summary: France's education minister announced that between 400 and 500 secondary schools would close on Monday when security conditions were not met, citing material damage or threats to staff.

stories.title: Maintien à gauche ou retour de l'extrême droite, scandales, craintes d'ingérences… Au Brésil, une élection présidentielle sous haute tension

en.title: Left continuity or return of the far right, scandals, fears of interference… In Brazil, a presidential election under high tension
en.summary: Brazil held its first round of presidential voting on Sunday, with incumbent Lula facing far-right candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro. A potential runoff was scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Un pont de Kiev attaqué par un drone russe pendant la visite surprise du chancelier allemand, Friedrich Merz, dans la capitale ukrainienne

en.title: A Kiev bridge attacked by Russian drone during surprise visit of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to Ukrainian capital
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made a surprise visit to Kiev, stating Ukraine needs support in the coming weeks. Russia continues to bomb essential infrastructure across the country.

stories.title: Lionel Messi et Cristiano Ronaldo : l'un part en héros, l'autre en star déchue

en.title: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo: one leaves as a hero, the other as a fallen star
en.summary: Lionel Messi was celebrated in Buenos Aires for his final appearance with Argentina after 208 matches. Cristiano Ronaldo departed the Portuguese national team during the same week under contentious circumstances.

stories.title: Le cancer du sein frappe de plus en plus de jeunes femmes en France

en.title: Breast cancer increasingly affecting young women in France
en.summary: Over 3,000 French women under 40 are diagnosed with breast cancer annually, with rising numbers and more aggressive forms of the disease presenting a research challenge.

stories.title: Le judo français, un colosse olympique en manque de domination

en.title: French judo, an Olympic giant lacking dominance
en.summary: With less than two years until the Los Angeles Olympics, no French judoka currently dominates their weight category, though strong results at the World Championships in Azerbaijan could alter this situation.

stories.title: Anne-Cécile Mailfert, présidente de la Fondation des femmes : « On veut arrêter de ramasser les victimes à la petite cuillère »

en.title: Anne-Cécile Mailfert, president of the Foundation for Women: "We want to stop picking up victims with a small spoon"
en.summary: A comprehensive law to combat sexual and gender-based violence is being examined in the National Assembly this week, with a solemn vote scheduled for October 13.

stories.title: Pétrole : sites cachés, réserves… Tout comprendre au stock stratégique français

en.title: Oil: hidden sites, reserves… Understanding France's strategic stockpile
en.summary: As France is called upon to draw from its petroleum reserves, the country's strategic stockpiles remain poorly understood in terms of ownership, storage location, and conditions for government release.
